OR3 Theme System — Security / Architecture Audit Pack

Scope: ONLY the refined theme engine (define/validate/compile/resolve), built-in + installed theme packages, v-theme runtime plugins, user override/background layers, theme admin install surfaces, compiler/CLI tooling, related docs, and tests.

Primary surfaces for review:
1. app/theme/_shared/* — defineTheme, validation, CSS var generation, selector runtime, resolver, manifest/loader, component overrides
2. app/plugins/00.theme-directive.ts + 90/91/92 theme plugins — bootstrap, SSR/client apply, auto-theme, lazy sync
3. plugins/vite-theme-compiler.ts + scripts/*theme* — build-time compilation
4. app/core/theme/* — merged theme apply, backgrounds, user overrides
5. server/admin/extensions/theme-install-sync.ts + shared extension install/URL fetch — how themes are installed from ZIP/URL
6. Theme packages: app/theme/{retro,blank} + extensions/themes/cyberpunk (text sources only)

Intentionally excluded: binary theme assets (PNG/JPG/etc), HTTP webhooks, chat feature plugins, Convex, plugin registries unrelated to theming, and the rest of the application.

Note: Theme ZIP/URL install reuses server/admin/extensions/* (same pipeline as plugins). Those install/SSRF files are included here so this pack is self-contained. Duplicate agent-skill theme doc copies under plugin-development/references were omitted; canonical docs live under public/_documentation/themes and docs/.
